productTitle: Microfiber Closed-Toe Mules with Buckle Strap
textDesc: Closed-toe mules with an open heel and a buckle strap. Microfiber upper, rubber outsole and cemented construction. Listed in Black, Sand and Brown, sizes 35-45. Send your color and size quantities, total quantity and destination for an order quotation.
companyDesc: Quanzhou Beiqiang Footwear & Apparel Co., Ltd. supports overseas B2B footwear inquiries. Company capabilities are shown below. Product-specific customization, samples, packing and dispatch arrangements are assessed against your order requirements before quotation.
companyFaqDesc: Which colors and sizes are listed?
Black, Sand and Brown, with listed sizes 35-45. Please send the quantity needed for each color and size. Size labels are not a US or EU conversion or a measured foot-length chart.
What materials and construction are confirmed?
Microfiber upper, rubber outsole and cemented construction. The upper is microfiber, not genuine leather. Include any additional material specification requirements with your inquiry.
What are the minimum order and quantity prices?
Minimum order: 2 pairs. 2-49 pairs: USD 16.80/pair; 50-99 pairs: USD 15.68/pair; 100+ pairs: USD 14.56/pair. Freight and order terms are quoted separately.
What does the closure and heel design look like?
The images show a closed toe, an open heel and a buckle strap. Review the product images for the actual strap and buckle arrangement.
What is the dispatch lead time?
Send your quantity and required dispatch date. Packing and dispatch timing are confirmed for the order; no fixed arrival date is promised.
How can I request a quotation?
Send your color and size quantities, total quantity, destination and packing requirements. Order-specific supply and order details are confirmed before the order is finalized.
